summary: This plugin manages media attachment size handling in DeepSeek Harness agent-loop calls by applying budgets, optional compression, deduplication, and overflow handling, with an optional web interface to view media-guard reports.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is safe multimodal request handling in DeepSeek Harness by governing image payloads per call: its README describes interception of `llm/stream` agent-loop requests, image budget accounting, compression/deduplication, overflow handling with evidence notes, and optional report surfacing. This is best classified as a media-focused utility rather than a core generation or analysis tool.
